2026_05_LV_NE.headline: New England’s defense confronts the Raiders’ revived passing attack
2026_05_LV_NE.paragraph1: New England returns home after Drake Maye led an upset of Buffalo, but Las Vegas presents a different test through Kirk Cousins and tight end Brock Bowers. The Raiders moved the ball competitively against Kansas City even as their rushing attack remained inconsistent following Ashton Jeanty’s strong opener. The Patriots can challenge that imbalance by tightening coverage and forcing Cousins to operate without easy early-down gains. Las Vegas must protect the quarterback and make New England defend the full field, rather than allowing Maye’s offense repeated favorable possessions.
2026_05_LV_NE.model_rationale: New England can exploit Las Vegas’s uneven rushing production by concentrating on coverage and passing downs. The Raiders need balanced drives to keep the Patriots’ defense from dictating terms.
